# PEANUTS: storage-buffer stores order buffer textures. The GPU particles' data is written by compute through storage buffers and read as buffer textures;
# without this the draws read it five frames late and torches and lights flicker (README.md, Effects; DM_VK_TBUF_GW_SB, docs/reference/rendering.md). On by recommendation

column4: Keeps fire, sparks and other effects in step with the game. Turn it off only to compare: torches and lights flicker without it
